selection.description: Quota 1 ranks by converted qualifying-exam average; the 2026 quota share was 30%, not a 2027 guarantee.
Quota 2 considers grades, higher subject levels and extra English proof alongside the strongly weighted creative video.
Three-minute creative video, introduction up to 30 seconds, maximum four projects. Submit a PDF with its YouTube link with the application.
Qualified applicants under the special non-EU conditions have a clarifying online interview; this is not stated as universal for EU applicants.

admission.capacityNote: 44 admitted in 2026, with 30% quota 1 and 70% quota 2; no 2027 capacity established.

requirements.label: IB Diploma, or qualifying DP Course Results

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The national recognition rule admits an IB Diploma or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three HL subjects to academy profession programmes through quotas 1 and 2. BAAA directs international applicants to the official qualification handbook; its own page does not separately describe Course Results. Subject requirements remain mandatory. Special non-EU application conditions and final-result timing require separate checks.

openFor.question: Does BAAA classify you under its completed-exam-before-application rule or its Danish-school/residence exception? Confirm residence and school location; a non-EU passport alone does not decide this.

requirements.label: Mathematics at C level or Economics at C level
English at B level, or an accepted English test

alternatives.label: An accepted English test
alternatives.note: English C remains required. IELTS Academic/Indicator 6.5; TOEFL/iBT Home Edition 4.5 or 94 (the page does not distinguish sitting dates/scales); Cambridge C1 Advanced 180; C2 Proficiency 200; Oxford Online Placement C1, at least 85 in each part, only at BAAA or approved partners. Valid for two years. BAAA must confirm score, sitting date and document deadline; the planner does not verify test scores.

requirements.label: Quota 1 ranks eligible applicants by their converted qualifying-exam average
Quota 2 considers your grades, higher subject levels and extra English proof
Quota 2 strongly weights a three-minute video of up to four creative projects
requirements.note: Introduce yourself on camera for up to 30 seconds, then explain projects, roles and creative process. Upload a PDF linking to the YouTube video with the application.

officialRequirementsText.text: English at the Danish C-level. [...] And Mathematics at the Danish C-level. [...] Or Economics at the Danish C-level. [...] The language requirement is English at the Danish B-level (at least 210 hours during the last three years of their upper-secondary education). However, if you only fulfil the specific entry requirement of English at C level, then the language requirement can be satisfied with an English test.

tuition.note: If fee-liable: EUR 24,000 across four semesters. Specified Danish permits exempt tuition; BAAA assesses actual status.

notes: AP: EQF 5, 120 ECTS, two years; the international line adds 10 programming ECTS. This is not a bachelor’s.
Admission area 81565; Sønderhøj 30, Viby J (Aarhus). English and 30 August 2027 start are published.
The general exam-completion rule is 5 July, with final diploma upload later under individual instructions. Do not infer an IB-final upload deadline or reject same-year IB candidates.
Fee-liable tuition EUR 6,000 per semester/EUR 24,000 total, valid from 2026; residence exemptions apply. Trip about EUR 550; laptop, materials and living costs extra.

outcomePathway.accreditation: Positive institutional accreditation through 30 September 2027 under the 2021 council decision.
outcomePathway.furtherStudy: This AP is shorter than a bachelor’s. AP entrants in 2027 cannot continue to the existing 1.5-year bachelor top-ups; Digital Concept Development has its final intake in August 2027. Confirm future further-study options before choosing the AP as a bachelor pathway.
